attribute.note: Values of id, name, class (full string and tokens), data-*, for, and aria-*. Empty values are ignored. data-mirror copies a separating value onto one page of the other label.

token.note: CountVectorizer unigrams, min_df=2, logistic regression, stratified out-of-fold AUC. Visible text excludes script, style, off-screen copy, and the #offer-1 evidence element.

structure.note: page_length is visible characters, including on-screen evidence and excluding off-screen text. n_cart_rows is the spec cart. n_hidden counts elements with the hidden attribute or class offscreen/parked.

length.note: relative gap is |mean trick - mean clean| / mean of those two means, per page kind.

overlap.note: training_specs refused the round when a train or dev page overlapped the test set.

near_duplicate.method: rapidfuzz.fuzz.ratio on rendered HTML with URLs removed
